english_meaning: An arrangement with a bank to keep and manage your money.
gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક સાથે પૈસા સુરક્ષિત રાખવા અને વ્યવસ્થાપિત કરવા માટેની વ્યવસ્થા.
usage_note: Types: savings account, current account, fixed deposit account.
memory_tip: 'Account' = 'ac' + 'count' = ગણ → account = ગણ ઠેલ (money counted and kept).
examples: She opened a savings account at the bank.
My account balance is very low this month.
Transfer the money to my account.
He has both a current and savings account.

english_meaning: Money placed into a bank account; also an advance payment to secure goods/services.
gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાં મૂકેલ પૈસા; અથવા ચીજ/સેવા સુરક્ષિત કરવા અગ્રિમ ચૂકવણી.
usage_note: A security deposit is a refundable amount paid before renting.
memory_tip: 'De' + 'posit' = ઠેકાણે + મૂક → deposit = ઠેકાણે (bank) મૂકો.
examples: She deposited ₹5,000 in her account.
Pay a deposit to reserve the hall.
The deposit will be returned after the tenancy.
He made a cash deposit at the ATM.

english_meaning: Taking money out of a bank account.
gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાંથી પૈસા ઉપાડવા.
usage_note: ATM withdrawals may be limited per day; bank withdrawals may need ID.
memory_tip: 'With' = સાથે + 'draw' = ખેંચ → withdrawal = ખાતામાંથી ખેંચ.
examples: I made a withdrawal of ₹2,000 from the ATM.
There's a daily withdrawal limit of ₹20,000.
She requested a withdrawal at the bank counter.
The withdrawal was processed instantly.

english_meaning: Money paid for the use of borrowed money, or earned on savings.
gujarati_meaning: ઉધાર પૈસા ઉપર ચૂકવાતી અથવા બચત ઉપર મળતી અધ-કચ.
usage_note: Simple interest vs. compound interest — compound grows faster.
memory_tip: 'Inter' = વચ્ચે + 'est' → interest = ઉધારી-ભરપાઈ વચ્ચે ઉમેરો.
examples: The bank pays 6% interest on savings.
He paid a lot of interest on his loan.
Interest rates are rising this year.
Compound interest grows faster than simple interest.

english_meaning: Money borrowed from a bank or person that must be repaid with interest.
gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક અથવા વ્યક્તિ પાસેથી ઉધાર લીધેલ પૈسا, જ્યારે વ્યાજ સાથે ભરવા પડે.
usage_note: Types: personal loan, home loan, car loan, education loan.
memory_tip: 'Loan' = ઉધારી → 'lend' → loan = ઉધાર/વ્યાજ સાથે.
examples: She took out a loan to buy a car.
The bank approved his home loan.
Loan repayment begins after six months.
He is struggling to pay back the loan.

english_meaning: A loan taken to buy property, with the property as security.
gujarati_meaning: મિલ્કત ખરીદવા માટે લોન, જ્યાં મિલ્કત ગિરવી/ગેરેન્ટી તરીકે રહે.
usage_note: If mortgage payments are missed, the bank can repossess the property.
memory_tip: 'Mort' = મૃત્યુ + 'gage' = બંધ → mortgage = 'ભારે' દેવાનો બંધ.
examples: They took out a 20-year mortgage to buy their home.
The mortgage payment is ₹25,000 per month.
Rising mortgage rates affect homebuyers.
She finally paid off her mortgage.

english_meaning: A numerical rating that represents a person's creditworthiness based on financial history.
gujarati_meaning: આર્થિક ઇતિહાસ આધારે વ્યક્તિની ધિરાણ-પ્રાયોગ્યતા દર્શાવતો આંકડો.
usage_note: In India, CIBIL score (300–900) is widely used; 750+ is considered good.
memory_tip: 'Credit' = ઉધારી + 'score' = ગુણ → credit score = ઉધારી-ગુણ = ભરોસો!
examples: A good credit score helps you get loans easily.
Check your credit score before applying.
Paying bills on time improves your credit score.
His credit score dropped after missing a payment.

english_meaning: When you withdraw more money from your account than you have, creating a debt.
gujarati_meaning: ખાતામાં જેટલા પૈसा ન હોય તેના કરતા વધારે ઉપાડ, જે ઋણ સર્જે.
usage_note: Banks may charge fees or interest on overdraft amounts.
memory_tip: 'Over' = વધારે + 'draft' = ઉપાડ → overdraft = ખાતા કરતા વધારે ઉપાડ.
examples: He went into overdraft after paying his bills.
The bank charges ₹500 as an overdraft fee.
She arranged an overdraft facility with her bank.
Avoid overdraft to prevent extra charges.

english_meaning: A printed or digital record of all transactions in a bank account over a period.
gujarati_meaning: ચોક્કસ સમય દરમ્યાન બૅન્ક ખાતાના બધા વ્યવહારોનો છાપેલ/ડિજિટલ અહેવાલ.
usage_note: Bank statements are important for tax filings and financial record-keeping.
memory_tip: 'State' = જણાવ + 'ment' = → statement = ખાતાની જાણ-ચિઠ્ઠી.
examples: Please send me my bank statement.
She checked her statement for errors.
Monthly statements are available online.
The statement shows all deposits and withdrawals.

english_meaning: A type of savings where money is deposited for a fixed period at a set interest rate.
gujarati_meaning: એક પ્રકારની બચત જ્યાં ચોક્કસ સમય માટે નક્કી વ્યાજ-દરે પૈસા જમા થાય.
usage_note: FDs offer higher interest than savings accounts but are not accessible before maturity without penalty.
memory_tip: 'Fixed' = નક્કી + 'deposit' = જમા → fixed deposit = ચોક્કસ સમય નક્કી જમા.
examples: She invested in a fixed deposit for 3 years.
The fixed deposit earns 7% interest.
He broke his FD early to pay for emergency.
Fixed deposits are a safe investment option.

english_meaning: An instance of buying, selling, or transferring money.
gujarati_meaning: ખરીદ, વેચ, અથવા પૈसा ટ્રાન્સફરની ઘટના.
usage_note: Each purchase, transfer, or payment is recorded as a transaction.
memory_tip: 'Trans' = આ-તરફ-ઉ-તરફ + 'action' = ક્રિયા → transaction = બે-પક્ષ ક્રિયા.
examples: The transaction was completed in seconds.
Check your transaction history online.
This transaction is pending approval.
Every ATM withdrawal is a transaction.

english_meaning: The amount of money available in a bank account.
gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાં ઉપલબ્ધ પૈसाની રકમ.
usage_note: 'Balance' can also mean the remaining amount owed on a debt.
memory_tip: 'Balance' = સ્થિર = ખાતામાં 'balance' = ઉપલબ્ધ.
examples: My account balance is ₹12,000.
Check your balance before making a payment.
The low balance alert saved me from overdraft.
She maintained a minimum balance of ₹10,000.

english_meaning: An asset pledged as security for a loan, which can be seized if the loan is not repaid.
gujarati_meaning: લોન માટે ગિરવી મૂકેલ સ્થાવર-જંગમ, ન ભરાય તો ઝૂંટવાઈ શકે.
usage_note: Common collaterals include property, gold, or fixed deposits.
memory_tip: 'Co' + 'lateral' = સાથે + બાજુ → collateral = બાજુ (side security).
examples: He offered his house as collateral for the loan.
Banks require collateral for large loans.
Gold jewellery is commonly used as collateral.
If you default, the bank takes the collateral.

english_meaning: One of several payments made at regular intervals for a purchase or loan.
gujarati_meaning: ખરીદ અથવા લોન માટે નિયમિત અંતરે ભરાતી અનેક ચૂકવણીઓ પૈકી એક.
usage_note: 'EMI' (Equated Monthly Instalment) is the Indian term for monthly loan instalments.
memory_tip: 'Install' = ઠેકઠેક ગોઠ → instalment = ઠેક-ઠેક ચૂક.
examples: She paid for the laptop in 12 instalments.
The monthly instalment is ₹3,500.
Buy now, pay later with easy instalments.
Missing an instalment attracts a penalty.

english_meaning: Money added to your account; also the ability to borrow money from a bank.
gujarati_meaning: ખાતામાં ઉમેરાયેલ પૈसा; અથવા બૅન્ક પાસેથી ઉધાર લેવાની ક્ષમતા.
usage_note: In banking: credit = money in (positive). Debit = money out (negative).
memory_tip: 'Cred' = ભરોસો (Latin) → credit = ભરોસા ઉપર ઉધારી.
examples: The refund was credited to my account.
She has a credit limit of ₹50,000 on her card.
His credit history is excellent.
Credit is useful but must be used wisely.

english_meaning: Money taken out of or charged to a bank account.
gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાંથી ઉઠાવેલ અથવા ચાર્જ કરાયેલ પૈसा.
usage_note: A debit card uses your own money; a credit card uses borrowed money.
memory_tip: 'Debit' = 'D' for 'Down' → debit = ખાતું ડાઉન (પૈसा ઉઠ્ઠ).
examples: The amount was debited from my account immediately.
She uses a debit card for everyday shopping.
Direct debits automatically pay bills.
Check debit entries in your statement monthly.

english_meaning: The percentage charged on a loan or paid on savings over a period.
gujarati_meaning: લોન ઉપર ચૂકવાતી અથવા બચત ઉપર મળતી ટકા-વ્યાજ-દ.
usage_note: RBI sets the benchmark interest rate in India, affecting all bank rates.
memory_tip: 'Interest' = વ્યાજ + 'rate' = દ → interest rate = વ્યાજ- દ.
examples: The interest rate on this loan is 12% per year.
Lower interest rates encourage borrowing.
The RBI raised the interest rate last month.
Compare interest rates before choosing a bank.

english_meaning: The system of money used in a country.
gujarati_meaning: દેશમાં ઉપયોગ થતી ચલણ-વ્યવસ્થા.
usage_note: India's currency is the Indian Rupee (INR); USA's is the US Dollar (USD).
memory_tip: 'Current' = ચાલુ/વહેણ → currency = ચલણ (ચાલતા-ઉપયોગ).
examples: The currency of Japan is the yen.
She exchanged currency at the airport.
Foreign currency can be exchanged at banks.
Digital currency is growing in popularity.

english_meaning: The rate at which one currency is exchanged for another.
gujarati_meaning: એક ચલણ બીજા ચલણ સાથે બદલાવાનો ભાવ-દ.
usage_note: Exchange rates fluctuate daily based on economic factors.
memory_tip: 'Exchange' = ફેર + 'rate' = ભાવ → exchange rate = ફેર-ભાવ.
examples: The exchange rate today is 83 rupees per dollar.
A favourable exchange rate helps travellers.
She monitored exchange rates before her trip.
Exchange rate changes affect import prices.

english_meaning: Physical money in the form of notes and coins.
gujarati_meaning: નોટ અને સિક્કા સ્વરૂપ ભૌtik ચૂકvidname.
usage_note: 'Cash in hand' means payment in physical money, often unreported.
memory_tip: 'Cash' = ઝટ/ટૂ → cash = ઝટ (instant) ભૂgtan!
examples: Do you accept cash or only cards?
She paid cash for the groceries.
He cashed a cheque at the bank.
Always carry some cash for emergencies.

english_meaning: A written order from a bank account holder to pay a specific amount to someone.
gujarati_meaning: ખાતાધારક દ્વારા ચોક્કસ રકમ ચૂkav વા બૅne ને ลed ituated nut ful ull karo nu likh लिखित.
usage_note: 'Cheque' is British spelling; 'check' is American. A bounced cheque means insufficient funds.
memory_tip: 'Cheque' = ચૅક → ભૂ-ling ene = ckek karo ke kem che balance!
examples: She wrote a cheque for the school fees.
The cheque bounced due to low balance.
Please issue a cheque in my name.
Cheques are being replaced by digital transfers.

english_meaning: Paying for goods or services electronically, using apps, cards, or online banking.
gujarati_meaning: એપ, કાર્ડ, અથવા ઑnline-banking દ્વારા ઇsb-electra-nic-riti-e ચૂkav.
usage_note: UPI (Unified Payments Interface) is India's popular digital payment system.
memory_tip: 'Digital' = ઇsb-net + 'payment' = ચૂk → digital payment = net ble ble chu.
examples: She made a digital payment using PhonePe.
Digital payments are faster and safer.
Most shops now accept digital payments.
UPI has made digital payments easy in India.

english_meaning: Unified Payments Interface — India's real-time digital payment system.
gujarati_meaning: Unified Payments Interface — ભarelyat nu real-time digital ચૂkav-system.
usage_note: UPI allows instant money transfer using a smartphone; e.g., Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm.
memory_tip: UPI = Unified (એક) + Payments (ચૂk) + Interface (system) = એક-system ble ble.
examples: She paid via UPI using her phone.
Share your UPI ID for the transfer.
UPI transactions are processed instantly.
UPI has revolutionized payments in India.

english_meaning: Personal Identification Number — a secret numeric code used to access bank accounts or cards.
gujarati_meaning: Personal Identification Number — bank account/card access ue secret numeric code.
usage_note: Never share your PIN with anyone, including bank employees.
memory_tip: PIN = Personal + Identification + Number = ful tama ri nal identification.
examples: Enter your PIN to complete the transaction.
She forgot her ATM PIN.
Change your PIN regularly for security.
Never share your PIN with anyone.

english_meaning: An electronic transfer of money from one bank account to another.
gujarati_meaning: એક bank account-ma-thi ble account-ma electronic riti-e paisa transfer karvu.
usage_note: NEFT and RTGS are India's bank wire transfer systems.
memory_tip: 'Wire' = ble net + 'transfer' = bo-dav → wire transfer = net thi paisa bodlav.
examples: He sent money via wire transfer.
International wire transfers may take 2–3 days.
Wire transfer fees vary by bank.
RTGS is used for large wire transfers.

english_meaning: A digital or virtual currency that uses cryptography for security.
gujarati_meaning: ble-cryptography-thi secured digital/virtual currency.
usage_note: Bitcoin and Ethereum are popular cryptocurrencies; highly volatile in value.
memory_tip: 'Crypto' = ble-secret + 'currency' = currency → crypto-currency = secret digital currency.
examples: He invested in cryptocurrency last year.
Bitcoin is the most popular cryptocurrency.
Cryptocurrency values can rise and fall sharply.
A crypto wallet stores your digital coins.

english_meaning: A payment method where you tap a card or phone on a reader without entering a PIN.
gujarati_meaning: card ya phone-ne reader ane ble tap kari, PIN vinana, ble chukavnu.
usage_note: Contactless payments use NFC (Near Field Communication) technology.
memory_tip: 'Contact-less' = ble sparsh vigna → contactless payment = sparsh na karo, paisa chukavo.
examples: She tapped her card for a contactless payment.
Contactless payments are fast and hygienic.
The contactless limit is ₹5,000 per transaction.
Most modern cards support contactless payment.

english_meaning: A small flat case for carrying cards, cash, and ID; also a digital app for storing money.
gujarati_meaning: card, cash ne ID ble rakhva-nu nano flat case; ya digital money store-karava-ni app.
usage_note: Digital wallets (Paytm, Google Pay) store money and cards virtually.
memory_tip: 'Wallet' = paisa nu ble ghar → wallet = wallet = paisa-nu ble ghar (house for money).
examples: She keeps her cards in a slim wallet.
His digital wallet has ₹2,000.
I left my wallet at home.
Digital wallets make payments convenient.

english_meaning: The exchange of one country's currency for another; also called forex.
gujarati_meaning: ble country-ni currency-ne ble-na country-ni currency-thi badlav; forex pan kahevay.
usage_note: Forex trading is the world's largest financial market by trading volume.
memory_tip: 'Foreign' = pardeshi + 'exchange' = ble bodlav → foreign exchange = ble desh-ni currency bodlav.
examples: She bought foreign exchange before her trip abroad.
The foreign exchange market operates 24/7.
Forex trading carries financial risks.
Banks and airports provide foreign exchange services.

english_meaning: Money sent to someone in another country, usually by a migrant worker to family back home.
gujarati_meaning: ble na-country-ni individual-thi ble country-ni family-ne paisa moklavy.
usage_note: India is one of the top recipients of remittances worldwide.
memory_tip: 'Remit' = ble moklav → remittance = ble na desh-e paisa moklav.
examples: He sends a remittance to his family in Gujarat every month.
India receives billions in remittances.
Remittance charges vary by service.
Western Union is a popular remittance service.

english_meaning: A payment arrangement where the total cost is divided into smaller regular payments.
gujarati_meaning: ble total cost-ne ble nana-nana regular payments-ma vadhu-ne chukavani vyavastha.
usage_note: Many banks offer no-cost EMI (equal monthly instalments) on credit card purchases.
memory_tip: 'Instalment' = ble tukde tukde + 'plan' = yojna → instalment plan = ble tukde-tukde chukavani yojna.
examples: She bought the fridge on an instalment plan.
The instalment plan is interest-free for 6 months.
Choose an instalment plan that fits your budget.
Many e-commerce sites offer instalment plans.

english_meaning: A reward or refund of a percentage of the amount spent, returned to the buyer.
gujarati_meaning: kharcha-ni rakami-na ble tikka paisa ble-khari-dnar-ne pacha apava-ni reward.
usage_note: Cashback is offered by credit cards, apps, and online stores as a reward.
memory_tip: 'Cash' = paisa + 'back' = pacha → cashback = ble kharcha-na paisa pacha!
examples: She earned 5% cashback on her credit card purchase.
The app gives ₹100 cashback on first order.
Cashback is credited within 7 working days.
Look for cashback offers while shopping online.

english_meaning: An automatic regular payment made from a bank account on a fixed date.
gujarati_meaning: ble nakkhi date-e bank account-ma-thi automatically niyamit payment karvu.
usage_note: Standing orders are used for rent, subscriptions, and regular fixed payments.
memory_tip: 'Standing' = nikhal padu + 'order' = hukam → standing order = ble auto-hukam.
examples: She set up a standing order to pay rent.
The standing order goes out on the 1st of each month.
Cancel the standing order if you no longer need it.
Standing orders ensure bills are paid on time.
